XERJ PACKS

Writing Pack

The intended writing workflow is outline → section → review.

Status

This pack is planned unless xerj tools list shows its xerj_write_* or xerj_writing_* tools. The catalog is authoritative.

Workflow

  1. Define the audience, claim boundary and accepted sources in the outline.
  2. Draft one section at a time and retain evidence for every factual claim.
  3. Run the review step for unsupported claims, citation gaps and scope drift before assembly.

Recipes stop when evidence is missing. They do not invent citations or present a declined tool as a finished result.
